entries.en: to divine; to tell fortunes by interpreting a hexagram
to be greatly amazed; to be astonished
entries.notes: H 栏‘生年’与 R 栏 sěng niên 对音可通，但该词组确切语义不明，释义依 source_L ‘admirarse mucho’ 定。
M 栏 hià̃ hià̃ nī 为叠音，H 栏‘乙’当为记音字，词组整体语义不能确考，依 source_L 定。

entries.en: to be startled; to take fright
to be shocked; to be alarmed
to be stunned; to be dumbfounded
entries.notes: H 栏‘錯愣’与 R 栏 chǒ nīo 对音不严整，然 L 与 H 义合，取‘错愕’义。

entries.zh: 惶遽；因事务繁多而心神不宁
entries.en: to be flustered; to be overwhelmed by many affairs
entries.notes: source_L 兼含‘惊异’与‘忙于多务’两义，H 栏‘愴惶’（仓惶）取惶乱义，R 栏对音有出入。

entries.en: to be startled; to take fear
to grant a request; to accept and comply
entries.notes: H 栏‘納勢’非习见词，R 栏 sȳ 与 M 栏 sŷ 仅记音，释义依 L 栏‘hacer lo que le ruegan’定。
M 栏夹注 [io chiacun.] 漫漶难辨，H/R 两栏‘養／yàng’互证‘收养’义。

entries.en: (of flesh) to go numb; to tingle
entries.notes: M 栏夹注 [herpon.] 不可解，或为原稿旁注，释义依 L 与 H 栏‘痲’定。
L 栏为动词短语而 H 栏作名词‘痲藥’，释义兼取麻木与麻药二义。
